grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: to have
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'How many + plural noun + do you have?' to ask about family members. Answer 'I have + number + plural noun' or 'I don't have any + plural noun' when the answer is zero.
grammarPoints.pattern: How many + plural noun + do you have? I have + number + plural noun. / I don't have any + plural noun.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: He / She and questions with who
grammarPoints.rule: Use 'she' for a girl or woman and 'he' for a boy or man. Ask 'Who's she?' or 'Who's he?' to ask who a person is, and answer with 'She's'/'He's' plus a description.
grammarPoints.pattern: Who's she/he? She's/He's + my + family member. She's/He's + adjective.

rules.title: Use she for a girl or woman
rules.subtitle: Use 'she' to talk about a girl or a woman, like a sister, mother, or grandmother.
rules.jp_subtitle: 姉妹や母、祖母のような女の子や女性について話すときは 'she' を使います。

rules.title: Use he for a boy or man
rules.subtitle: Use 'he' to talk about a boy or a man, like a brother, father, or grandfather.
rules.jp_subtitle: 兄弟や父、祖父のような男の子や男性について話すときは 'he' を使います。

rules.title: Ask Who's she/he? to ask about a person
rules.jp_title: 人について尋ねるときは 'Who's she/he?'
rules.subtitle: Use 'who' plus a form of 'be' to ask about a person. 'Who's' is the normal contraction of 'who is.'
rules.jp_subtitle: 人について尋ねるときは 'who' の後にbe動詞を続けます。'Who's' は 'who is' の短縮形として普通に使われます。

rules.title: Answer who questions with She's/He's
rules.jp_title: whoの質問には 'She's/He's' で答える
rules.subtitle: Answer a 'who' question with 'She's' or 'He's' plus a description of the person.
rules.jp_subtitle: 'who' の質問には 'She's' か 'He's' の後に人の説明を続けて答えます。

japanese.title: He / She と who を使った疑問文
japanese.rule: 女の子や女性には 'she'、男の子や男性には 'he' を使います。人について尋ねるときは 'Who's she?' や 'Who's he?' と言い、'She's'/'He's' の後に説明を続けて答えます。
japanese.pattern: Who's she/he? She's/He's + my + 家族の呼び方. She's/He's + 形容詞.
